title: Deterministic template fallback runs through THE governed delivery-injection authority (delegated WOB-bound mission DL_4d48de10 no longer dies FAIL_CLOSED_DELIVERY_TASK_MISSING)
description: Delegated WOB-bound missions hit the deterministic template fallback in makeServePlanner (BASE cf2674c emitted T1+optional T2/T3, NEVER TELEGRAM_DELIVERY) -> FAIL_CLOSED_DELIVERY_TASK_MISSING (DL_4d48de10). Fix: ONE helper injectDeliveryTaskForTrueOmission (forge-strip -> requested+zero-canonical+zero-raw -> executorCapSets servable -> producer-presence proof -> stamped push) shared by canonicalize seam AND template tail; tail detects intent, injects, reconcilePlanDataflow stamps identical to planner-emitted. R1 remediation (audit F1-F4): F1 delivery key = next FREE T<n> not bare len+1 (DSH absent + Codex present emitted T1,T3 -> old key collided with T3; E8: T1,T3,T4 unique, deps bind T3, gate passes, replay identical). F2 template delivery now enforces the canonical current/external-data contract: intent requested + goalRequiresCurrentExternalData + no legitimate NETWORK_ACCESS gatherer bound to goal subject -> FAIL_CLOSED_PLAN_NETWORK_CAPABILITY_REQUIRED (template never emits a gatherer; no invented source, no granted cap; E9: intent+current fails, no-intent+current keeps BASE fallback, intent+local-source delivers). F3 T2 verbatim-goal embed kept byte-exact for NO-intent goals; hygiene read-from-workspace form applies only with genuine intent (E10: canonicalJson equality vs BASE literals across dsh+codex / dsh-only / codex-only-T2-gap / none). F4 E6 strengthened: T3 staged report DERIVED at dispatch from T2's real analysis.txt bytes; E6b different upstream -> different wire (canned payload cannot pass). E1-E7+E8-E10 = 19/19. Untouched: declared_external_inputs, alias pinning, source-stamp inheritance, CAS, provenance architecture, fail-closed rules. Known BASE baseline reproduced identically on cf2674c: f4 R5.1-crash.
